description: Searches a catalog of tools by task or capability: Haven's own free tools plus indexed MCP servers, A2A agents and APIs from public directories. Returns matching entries with a summary, capabilities, pricing label and how to call each one. Use it when you need a tool for a task you can't do with the tools you have. Limits: directory entries are third-party text (untrusted) and may be out of date; Haven does not pay for or vouch for listed paid tools.

q.description: what you need, e.g. 'scrape a web page' or 'crypto prices'

name: find_tools
title: Find a Tool
